summary: Phase 5 (Super Admin / Platform portal + real /api/billing/payment-request) tested end-to-end. 28/28 backend tests pass, full UI flow works on /superadmin (login, dashboard KPIs, clinics filter+detail+actions, payments queue, announcements CRUD, logout) and /billing/checkout (real payment-request with file upload shows checkout-success). Regressed iter5 saas tests (10/10 still pass). No critical issues found.
action_items: (P2 / nice-to-have) Render the uploaded payment proof image link / thumbnail in /superadmin/payments queue rows. Currently only metadata is shown.

(P3) Existing test files /app/backend/tests/test_saas.py and test_bookings.py require REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL to be exported when running pytest (no default). Not a regression — same as iter5/iter6. Consider adding a conftest.py that loads /app/frontend/.env.
critical_code_review_comments: Subscription update extend_days logic correctly branches on status==trial (extends trial_end) vs other (extends expiry_date) from max(now, current) — verified in test_extend_days_trial.
Payment verify endpoint is idempotent (already-verified payments return verified without re-extending) — verified in test_verify_idempotent.
Multi-tenant isolation enforced: non-platform-admin users (even with role=super_admin) get 403 on all /api/superadmin/* endpoints — verified in TestAccessControl + TestMultitenant.
Plan validation rejects unknown plan ids with 400 (test_unknown_plan_400, test_invalid_plan_400). Status validation rejects invalid status (test_invalid_status_400).
MRR matches sum of PLAN_CATALOG prices for active clinics — verified numerically (test_dashboard_mrr_matches_active).
test_credentials: Platform: platform@clinicos.id / ClinicOS@2026 ; Clinic owner: owner@cantikbeauty.id / password123 (and other owner@*.id from /app/memory/test_credentials.md)
seed_data_creation: Tests create + verify + reject several payment_request docs via /api/billing/payment-request (auto cleaned: cantikbeauty restored to starter/active in session teardown). One TEST_UI_announcement left in DB from frontend smoke test (low-impact).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_superadmin.py contains a session-scoped teardown that restores cantikbeauty (used as the E2E payment-verify target) back to plan=starter, status=active. Run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<public-url> pytest backend/tests/test_superadmin.py. The fixture target_clinic_id resolves to rena skin for subscription-mutation tests (so cantikbeauty is reserved only for the payment-verify E2E). data-testids confirmed live: sa-login-form, sa-email, sa-password, sa-submit, sa-dashboard-kpis, sa-kpi-mrr/clinics/pending/trials, sa-nav-clinics/payments/announcements, sa-clinics-table, sa-clinic-row-{slug}, sa-clinic-open-{slug}, sa-clinic-detail, sa-action-activate/suspend/extend/plan-{plan}, sa-payments-table, sa-payment-row-{id}, sa-verify-{id}, sa-reject-{id}, sa-announcement-form, sa-ann-title/body/submit, sa-ann-row-{id}, sa-logout. Checkout page testids: checkout-page, checkout-total, checkout-success, proof-input, payment-submit.
